verdict.rationale: The vendor states you can 'compute your bill before you talk to us' and compare one-to-one against your current managed ClickHouse spend, which implies a self-serve cost estimator. A free developer tier with stated resource limits is also documented. However, the pack contains no actual unit prices, pricing dimensions (compute, storage, egress) or calculator details, and the cost audit is sales-assisted rather than self-serve. Missing for 10: published per-unit rates and billing dimensions, evidence of how the bill calculator works, documentation of paid-tier pricing, independent confirmation that estimates match real bills.
